# BEGIN ShipStatic Lockdown
# Generated by ShipStatic: only the allowed addresses reach this site.
# Locked out? Open your unlock link, or delete this block to turn Lockdown off.
<IfModule mod_rewrite.c>
RewriteEngine On
__BS_INHERIT__
# Hand the Authorization header to PHP (PHP-FPM drops it otherwise), so the
# gate sees a bearer key too. WordPress's own block does the same.
RewriteCond %{HTTP:Authorization} .
RewriteRule .* - [E=HTTP_AUTHORIZATION:%{HTTP:Authorization}]
# Certificate renewals. THE_REQUEST, not REQUEST_URI: it stays the same when
# WordPress's rules rewrite to index.php and Apache runs these rules again.
# Only plain paths: no ".." or other dot segments, no %-escapes, no query.
# Each segment starts with its "/", so the pattern can't backtrack.
RewriteCond %{THE_REQUEST} !^[A-Z]+\s/\.well-known(?:/[A-Za-z0-9_~-][A-Za-z0-9._~-]*)*/?\s
__BS_FORMS__
RewriteCond %{HTTP:X-BS-Render-Token} !^__BS_TOKEN__$
RewriteCond %{QUERY_STRING} !(^|&)unlock=__BS_KEY__(&|$)
RewriteCond %{HTTP:Authorization} !^[Bb][Ee][Aa][Rr][Ee][Rr]\s+__BS_KEY__\s*$
RewriteCond %{HTTP_COOKIE} !(^|;\s*)__BS_COOKIE_NAME__=__BS_COOKIE__(;|$)
__BS_IPS__
__BS_RULE__
</IfModule>
# END ShipStatic Lockdown
